what: ink accuracy against public labels when inkrs leaves villa or hecate.py parity (larger strides; bf16 for Hecate), scored per segment with paired differences against parity mode under a rule fixed before the first GPU job; and a timing of the parity and faster settings against villa and hecate.py in one job
build: an earlier inkrs build, before this tree's stem kernels and start-up changes

method.crop: each segment is cropped to its label mask's bounding box plus 128 px, except the three PHerc. 0841 segments, which are whole; every setting runs on the same crop
method.depth: depth 0 only, 17 layers about the centre (PHerc. 343: layers 25 to 41)
method.mask: the label's own mask, less every pixel whose CT column in the crop is all zero; ink is label > 127; pixels a map does not cover score 0
method.metrics: pixel AUC (primary) and average precision, computed exactly from 256-bin histograms

ci.kind: percentile bootstrap over blocks of the label grid; differences use paired resamples

method.sides: readers run both directions; the scored side is the one where reader-v2 at stride 64 scores higher, and readers are also checked on the other side where reader-v2 there reaches AUC 0.6 or more. Hecate runs the scored side only
rule: the paired 95% CI of the AUC difference has its lower end at or above -0.005
the point AUC difference is at or above minus the half-width of parity mode's own 95% AUC CI on that segment
the paired 95% CI of the AP difference has its lower end at or above -0.01
method.rule_scope: a setting passes when every check holds on every segment that counts for its model
method.exposure: clean: no training exposure found; counted: the segment's scroll was the model's held-out evaluation or selection set, or its exposure is unknown; a segment the model trained on, or may be part of an object it trained on, is ranked but not counted. reader-v2 and the ensemble have no clean segment, so their verdict can only read 'agrees with these labels as well as parity mode does', never 'better than villa'

references.ens: ens-rv2s64+bf16-s32 (reader-v2 at stride 64 with Hecate bf16 at stride 32, averaged after a bilinear resize of the Hecate map)

method.names: rv2 is reader-v2, seed42 is hybrid_3d2d-seed42, sN is the stride (64 is overlap 0.5), ~alt is the other side
method.speed: gpu_s_per_map is event-timed GPU time per map on the labelled crops, for ranking settings only; wall-clock speed-ups are in timing

1447-w058.labels: Youssef Nader's refined labels, Hugging Face ink-8um-pherc1447-surfaces w058 (CC BY-NC 4.0)

0841-w00.labels: the organisers' 2.4 µm ink labels of 2026-09-18, resampled

0139-w043.labels: the organisers' labels; ranked only, every model here trained on it or may have

ensemble_vs_single_models.note: every one of these segments is a selection or held-out evaluation segment for at least one of the two models, so this comparison is exploratory

timing.what: one job on the whole PHerc. 1447 segment, each villa or hecate.py run next to its inkrs counterpart; each wall runs from process start to exit, with model load, volume reads and map writes. Readers: native 31 x 2980 x 3240, depths -2..2, both directions, 10 maps. Hecate: the segment resampled to 9.6 µm, 28 x 2682 x 2916, one side, 1 map. villa at its plain defaults was not timed

villa-tuned.tool: villa main, --batch-size 8 --no-compile --loader-threads 8 --chunk-cache-size 64, one process per depth

hecpy-default.tool: hecate.py at its defaults (fp32 with TF32, batch 1)
